# Font test data

`DejaVuSansMono.ttf` is used only by the Font module's unit tests
(`@embedFile`, so they do not depend on system fonts). It is the unmodified
file `ttf/DejaVuSansMono.ttf` from the official DejaVu Fonts 2.37 release
(sha256 `b4a6c3e4faab8773f4ff761d56451646409f29abedd68f05d38c2df667d3c582`).
